3899-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1563-2457-4365-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2921-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3179-4399-4770-6823.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-3291-4785.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4785.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2440-3263-4183-7747.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-4183-7747.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant with haste.
When the token Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Giant-Sized Flying Ant trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
Repeat.

2024-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G/W}{G/W}, untapping Topiary Lecturer and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2024-7488.notes: The amount of mana needed to start is equal to {2}{G/W}{G/W} minus an amount of {G} equal to Topiary Lecturer's power.

206-1682-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-1682-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

206-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens

Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.

3259-5485-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

414-4613-5663.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4613-5663.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
When the Insect enters, Cayth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Insect. This causes it to gain Grist's abilities due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

4136-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4136-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2366-3512-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.

Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

549-2919-3197-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2919-3197-6830.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating at least one artifact creature token.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3139-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-3139-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5670-6458-6792--5.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6458-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

957-2974-6689.easyPrerequisites: You control four or more artifacts.
957-2974-6689.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
During your first extra turn, cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing it to exploit itself. Its second ability then triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Golbez's second ability triggers, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5747-6243-6798--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5747-6243-6798--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6487-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-6487-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Phantom Train ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1323-3717-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Viridian Joiner's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

Draw a card.

When the Insect enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 6 through 9 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

186-913-3525-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
186-913-3525-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2061-2103-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-5913.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Havi, adding one mana of any color.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.

1069-1753-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1753-2457-5499.description:

Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.

Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

292-5016-5358.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Spitemare.
292-5016-5358.description:
Deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Spitemare.
Rite of Passage and Spitemare trigger twice.
Resolve both Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spitemare.
Resolve the first Spitemare trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to any target.
Resolve the second Spitemare trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1504-2232-2421-2459-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh and You have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
1504-2232-2421-2459-4050.description:

Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.

When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Cast Miara by paying {1}{B}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Miara enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

914-1170-2493-4598.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.

Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.

When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

819-869-3584-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
819-869-3584-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Memory Lapse, with each copy targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating at least one Treasure token.
Resolve the first copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining copies of Memory Lapse fizzle due to having no legal target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1637-1987-2404-4423.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three other Islands.
You control at least two additional creatures.
1637-1987-2404-4423.description:

Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Aesi triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3990-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Incubation Druid.
